items.name: Orca
items.text: Orcas live in family groups called pods. Each pod has its own set of calls, a bit like a family accent. Some orcas in these waters eat mostly salmon.

items.name: Humpback whale
items.text: Once rare here, humpbacks are back. Watch for a spout and a tail flip.

items.name: White-sided dolphin
items.text: Fast, playful and social. Sometimes they leap beside boats.

items.name: Harbour seal
items.text: Spotted coats, puppy faces. They rest on rocks at low tide.

items.name: Bull kelp
items.text: A seaweed that grows into a tall underwater forest in a single summer.

items.name: Chinook salmon
items.text: The biggest Pacific salmon, and a favourite food of local orcas.

items.name: Giant octopus
items.text: Three hearts, blue blood, and it can change colour in a blink.

items.name: Glass sponge reef
items.text: Scientists thought reefs like these vanished long ago, until they were found living off BC.
